How We Work

Our Installation Process

A proven, systematic approach from initial survey to final certification.

01

Site Survey

Comprehensive assessment of your facility, existing infrastructure, and future requirements.

02

Design & Planning

Detailed cabling design, route planning, materials list, and project timeline.

03

Supply & Procurement

Quality-assured materials sourced from certified manufacturers at competitive pricing.

04

Installation

Professional installation by certified technicians following TIA/EIA-568 standards.

05

Testing & Certification

Fluke DSX-8000 cable analyser testing with full pass/fail certification reports.

06

Handover & Documentation

As-built drawings, test reports, labelling schedules, and warranty documentation.
